officialText:
Section 545.1 – Revise Section 545.1 to read as follows:

545.1 Scope. Part I of this article covers requirements for department-approved manufactured building and building components as herein defined. Part II covers relocatable structures and the conductors that connect relocatable structures to a supply of electricity.

Exception: Factory manufactured one- and two-family homes or multiple dwellings of not more than 2 stories or less in height, provided such multiple dwellings are not intended for use as hotels or motels, are not subject to the requirement of this code. Such dwellings shall comply with NY State Uniform Fire Prevention, Building Codes, and governing laws for Manufactured Buildings, as stipulated in New York State executive law section 383 as amended.

Informational Note: As per Title 19 of the Rules of the City of New York Part 1209.5, an Insignia of Approval will be attached to manufactured homes installed in the State of New York.
